limitations: Spark route: Playtest was not run.
No physical print, fit, running performance, traction, latch durability or elastic life has been demonstrated.
A separate elastic loop and plastic-compatible adhesive are required; no band size or safe stretch rating is qualified.
Initial trial is limited to at most one quarter rear-wheel turn; do not increase winding to overcome slip or binding.
Adult assembly and supervised use; small parts must be kept away from children under three.
Mechanised adaptation of a side photograph, not an exact scale replica.
product.summary: An angular 180 x 78 x 60 mm Cybercab-inspired elastic-drive toy design with a removable body, replaceable loop and rear-axle winding finger. Adult assembly is required.
product.title: Cybercab Elastic Drive
what_arrives: Design for eight rigid printed pieces: one shell, one chassis, two axle-and-wheel pieces, two keyed end wheels and two window inserts.
Four-page printable owner guide covering assembly, loop fitting, shell release, initial quarter-turn trial, reset and care.
